name: mnb/mnb-phpexcel-xlsx
description: Native XLSX reader/writer, formula engine, pivot generation, and low-memory streaming module for MNB PHPExcel.

suggest.ext-zip: Recommended for native high-performance XLSX package access; a pure-PHP fallback is included.
suggest.ext-xmlreader: Recommended for true streaming XLSX reads; a pure-PHP fallback is included.
suggest.phpoffice/phpspreadsheet: Adds compatibility for specialist formulas outside the expanded native formula engine.
